    https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=14912

    Same as https://github.com/aquynh/capstone/pull/1684 for next branch

diff --git a/MCInst.c b/MCInst.c
index 2d0aec92..4c39f999 100644
--- a/MCInst.c

        }
